name: Ray Marching with SDFs and Soft Accumulation
aliases: Jellyfish Ray Marching with Soft Accumulation
definition: A ray marching technique that renders a school of jellyfish using signed distance functions (SDFs) for the bell, tentacles, and arms, combined with soft accumulation to anti-alias hair-thin strands across frames.
summary: This rendering technique prevents flickering in hair-thin geometry by replacing hard surface intersections with smooth, exponential soft accumulation based on distance to the surface.
